method: normalized terminal-outcome turn-level leave-one-out PPO; no geodesic progress or semantic verifier reward
control: existing exact512 outcome-only GRPO checkpoints at seeds 11, 22, and 33, subject to source and evaluation reuse audit
evaluation: R2R val-unseen, 1839 paired episodes per seed, one decode per episode at the matching seed, four shards, identical evaluator and manifest to verified controls
evaluation_schedule: After all three candidate checkpoints and training-gradient audits pass, evaluate seeds 11 and 22 concurrently on separate inference GPUs and seed 33 afterward, using the same four-shard evaluator for every seed.
limitations: The pilot val-seen split and larger val-unseen replication have been used during method development. Passing a one-seed pilot is only a resource-allocation rule, not robust evidence; full val-unseen is not a clean final test.
decision_basis: User explicitly requested exploratory scaling after seeing 256-episode seed11 pilot SR +1.953125 pp and SPL +1.2572758274862095 pp. Original predeclared +2/+2 gate failed and original scale watcher skipped. This is a new post-result exploratory run, not a passed gate.
n8_budget: 256 unique train rows x 64 optimizer steps x n=8, versus n=4 pilot 256 rows x 64 steps x n=4; n=8 uses twice the simulator rollouts; report compute and do not attribute any difference to group size alone.
n8_evaluation: Reuse same frozen third 256 val-seen manifest and exact baseline/n4 raw episodes; adaptive development comparison only.
n4_original_gate_status: failed: paired SR +1.953125 pp and SPL +1.2572758274862095 pp, both below the frozen joint +2/+2 pp condition; original scale watcher skipped
